title.narrative: Direct-to-Consumer Approaches to Fertility Awareness & Reproductive Health Information for Adolescents (DTC) - Game of Choice, Not Chance

description.narrative: Howard-Delafield International will work with partners Girl Effect, Virginia Serious Game Institute at George Mason University, Cycle Technologies, Indusgeeks and Vihara in India to pilot a program that combines interactive, story-based video games and educational e-learning tools to engage and educate adolescent girls and their support networks so that they can make more informed decisions across a range of age-appropriate health situations.
